title: Reproducible Analysis Code and Zero-Refit Bedside Classifier: Baseline and 48-Hour Dynamic Host-Response States From Six Routine Blood Tests After Traumatic Brain Injury (v1.1.0)
description: Public MIT-licensed reproducible code, frozen 45-parameter three-state Gaussian mixture classifier, standalone zero-refit six-test bedside state calculator, external Decision Curve Analysis (DCA), conventional ICU severity-score benchmarks (Motor/Total GCS, APACHE IV/IVa, SAPS 3), and aggregate verification tables across MIMIC-IV v3.1, eICU-CRD v2.0, SICdb v1.0.8, and HiRID v1.1.1 (N = 8,130). Contains zero patient-level data in strict compliance with PhysioNet Data Use Agreements.
